name: Portal Graveyard
introDiscord:
Broken portals drift like ruined doors.

Some lead nowhere.

Some flicker with dead landscapes.

One repeatedly opens onto a broom closet.
introTwitch:
Broken portals drift like ruined doors.

Some lead nowhere.

Some flicker with dead landscapes.

One repeatedly opens onto a broom closet.

portal-graveyard-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Portal Graveyard.

left.message: A Portalgrave Prowler emerges from a shattered doorway.

right.message: A coffer has been stranded inside a portal that forgot its destination.

forward.message: A damaged gate opens briefly onto a peaceful Moonlit tide.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

portal-graveyard-depths.prompt: Deeper within Portal Graveyard, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: Star Candies rest inside a portal frame with no portal.

right.message: A Prowler leaps through three dead gateways.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's memorial:

'RIP portal.

Destination unknown.

You were probably confusing anyway.'

portal-graveyard-threshold.prompt: Near Sepulcher of Exits, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A half-functioning gate remembers an old restorative spring.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A cache is built from fragments of broken portal frames.

forward.message: A Portalgrave Prowler guards the oldest dead gate.

boss-antechamber.name: Sepulcher of Exits
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Sepulcher of Exits begins collecting broken portals into one towering
arch.

bossPromptDiscord:
Sepulcher of Exits begins collecting broken portals into one towering
arch.

Use /yes to approach or /no to avoid whatever collects
dead doors.
bossPromptTwitch:
Sepulcher of Exits begins collecting broken portals into one towering
arch.

Use !yes to approach or !no to avoid whatever collects
dead doors.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Sepulcher of Exits. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The broken gates lock around a massive shape.

Dead-Gate Collector reveals itself!

completionText:
The graveyard scatters again.

One broken portal flickers briefly.

Behind it:

an ocean you have never seen.
